source_rank.usage: Visible row order on the successfully parsed CBS Sports kicker projection page.

Rank.usage: Deterministic K-only projection ranking and list-length-aware percentile input.
Rank.normalization: projected_fantasy_points descending, FGM descending, XPM descending, source_player_id

cross_source_comparison.independence_note: CBS Sports is a direct projection provider. FantasyPros Projection Consensus may itself include CBS Sports, so do not count both as independent CBS evidence in a composite without explicit de-duplication.

league_adjustments: Keep CBS distance-bucket, FGM/FGA and XPM/XPA projections independent of the provider fantasy-point formula.
Do not treat CBS FPTS as the Mighty Giants league scoring result unless the scoring formulas are explicitly reconciled.
Apply the six-team replacement level and one fixed kicker starter during analysis.
Use current kicker job and competition evidence separately from the projection ranking.
limitations: The audited public page does not expose a reliable projection-specific Updated timestamp.
No documented public Projection API contract was confirmed on the audited CBS Sports surface.
The HTML parser depends on the public table and official CBS NFL player-link structure.
Projection values are provider estimates and can change materially during training camp and the season.
